birth.note: saint.gr's head line reads «Αγιος Ιωαννης ο Νεομαρτυρας ο Βουλγαρος ο Χρυσοχοος (1784 - 1802)»; the body gives no birth year and calls him eighteen years old at his death.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 14ης Μαΐου — «Άγιος Ιωάννης ο Νεομάρτυρας ο Βούλγαρος ο χρυσοχόος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 14 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and the body repeats it in the date of death. **He is none of the corpus's very many Johns**, which the namesweep flagged and which were read; the town, the trade, the year and the age settle it. **The display name keeps the trade and the town and drops «ο Βούλγαρος»**, the trade being how the calendar tells him from the day's other new martyrs and the town being what the page gives him: «καταγόταν από την πόλη Σούμνα της Βουλγαρίας», Shumen. **`dates` takes the birth year from the head line only** and its note says so; the body says only that he was eighteen. **The hieromonk Nikephoros of Chios, who wrote his martyrdom, has no folder** and is named without a link. **No `locations` object.** No hymn is printed.
